sql: select r.verdict, r.computed_at::text as computed, c->>'list' as clause_list, (c->'clause')->>'metric' as metric, (c->'clause')->>'op' as op, (c->'clause')->>'value' as threshold, c->>'value' as observed, c->>'n' as n, c->>'passed' as passed from experiment_gate_results r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements((r.metrics_json)::jsonb->'clauses') c join experiment_gates g on g.id=r.gate_id join experiment_versions v on v.id=g.version_id where v.experiment_id=(select id from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') and g.gate_key='live_canary_keep' and r.id=(select max(r2.id) from experiment_gate_results r2 join experiment_gates g2 on g2.id=r2.gate_id join experiment_versions v2 on v2.id=g2.version_id where v2.experiment_id=(select id from experiments where key='mmsell-price-ceiling-capacity') and g2.gate_key='live_canary_keep') order by c->>'list', metric
